description: Modified-sandwich SettingsModel checkpoint: Profile inheritance/local-ownership, nullable icon layering, environment-map, strict GUID identity and appearance/property layering contracts have direct safe Rust ownership and Microsoft-derived witnesses.

entries.notes: The safe Rust ProfileSettings owner resolves historySize from profiles.defaults, retains the built-in snapOnInput=true fallback when no layer defines it, and lets an explicit profile value override only that child layer.
A child profile initially owns layered historySize/tabTitle values; clearing each local value flips HasXxx false and resolves the corresponding parent value without copying it into the child layer.

The Rust owner distinguishes local ownership from inherited resolution: explicit profile historySize reports Has=true, inherited defaults historySize/tabTitle report Has=false on children, and profiles.defaults itself retains Has=true for its locally-defined value.
The safe Rust Profile owner reproduces Microsoft's nullable icon layering: an explicit null clears the icon, an omitted icon preserves the current layer result, and a later string replaces it.

The safe Rust Profile owner parses the environment object as a typed string map and preserves all three Microsoft values verbatim, including the self-referential %VAR_3%;value3 payload without premature expansion.

The safe Rust Profile owner keeps absent/null GUIDs unset, accepts zero/lowercase/uppercase braced format-B GUIDs as the same identity, and rejects Microsoft's hyphenless, raw and parenthesized presentations.

Profile children inherit background, selection background and starting directory from the resolved parent while locally layered foreground/name/directory values replace only their own layer, matching Microsoft's three-profile chain.
